d: Raja pretends to be a cop in order to impress the woman he loves and she dumps him on learning the truth. When they meet again, he has a good job, but there is someone else who is in love with him. Initia

Vijay escapes prison after being falsely convicted and joins Radha, whose car contains the body of a wealthy man murdered by his own son. Hunted by police, they uncover the truth, fall in love, and fight to expose the real killers.

Rajesh believes that Lawrence was killed by his psychologically disturbed wife and dumps the body. However, when the police suspect Lawrence's wife, he tries to help her but becomes a suspect himself.
